statement_made: I think I'm a very technical pass rusher. I have good size and speed... I’m going to come in there and show people that I’m a really good football player.
event_description: Describing his technical approach to rushing the passer during a post-draft media session.

statement_made: I think I’m a dominant run blocker at the point of attack, but I don’t think people give me enough credit for my passing ability.
event_description: Discussing his dual-threat potential as a tight end for the Dolphins.

statement_made: I play with the switch. On the field you check out the film, that's how I play; but off the field, I feel like I'm a pretty genuine guy.
event_description: Describing the contrast between his aggressive on-field persona and his off-field personality.

statement_made: We’re going to run the [expletive] out of the ball.
event_description: Boldly stating the offensive identity the Dolphins' new line intends to establish.

statement_made: I was a fifth-generation Longhorn... I just knew that if you believe in yourself and do what your heart is telling you, anything is possible.
event_description: Reflecting on his journey from a walk-on at Texas to being drafted into the NFL.

statement_made: You’ve got to earn your stripes early. You’ve got to put your head down and not say a word and be humble.
event_description: Discussing his leadership philosophy as a rookie entering the Dolphins' locker room.

statement_made: I think we’re [bleeping] starving. I got a new contract, but it don’t change the goals or the ambition I got for this team.
event_description: Expressing the hunger of the Chargers defense following his contract extension.

statement_made: I don't like to try to force things, I just like to be myself. I’m always willing to help the younger guys because knowledge shouldn't be hoarded.
event_description: Sharing his approach to veteran leadership and mentoring younger players on the Chargers.

statement_made: A leader, tough as hell, somebody that loves to play football, maniacal preparer... Somebody that's going to give their team everything they got.
event_description: Raiders GM outlining the traits the team prioritized when selecting their franchise quarterback.

statement_made: It’s a huge responsibility, but it’s also a huge honor to honor the legacy... I need to prove it and earn it every single day.
event_description: Discussing the weight of following in the footsteps of Raiders legends after being drafted.

statement_made: I’m just excited for the journey. Coming from South Africa to Chicago, I’m ready to show what I can do on the field.
event_description: First media appearance after being drafted in the 6th round by the Bears.

statement_made: I pride myself on attacking the ball. I want to be the guy making the play, no matter where it is on the field.
event_description: Reacting to being drafted 166th overall by the Chicago Bears.

statement_made: I have football in my blood. I’m looking to make an impact in every phase of the game, offense or special teams.
event_description: Bears' third-round tight end discussing his versatility and family legacy in football.

statement_made: I’m bringing versatility. Whether it’s return game or wideout, I’m here to contribute to this Bears offense.
event_description: Introductory press conference for the Bears' third-round wide receiver selection.

statement_made: Coming to Chicago just felt like it was meant to be. I’m ready to bring my speed to this secondary.
event_description: Reflecting on being selected 25th overall by the Bears.

statement_made: Dillon (Thieneman) is everything we’re looking for. He’s got the range and the instincts that elevate our defense.
event_description: Bears GM recapping the first-round selection of safety Dillon Thieneman.

statement_made: We added some real playmakers this weekend. Our goal was to find guys who fit our culture and enhance our identity.
event_description: Bears HC summarizing the team's draft results.

statement_made: I’ve been waiting for this day. It’s an honor to be recognized with the Piccolo Award alongside TJ.
event_description: Bears tight end Colston Loveland addressing the media after receiving the 2026 Brian Piccolo Award.

statement_made: This award means a lot. It’s about the work you put in when nobody is watching. Grateful to be part of this group.
event_description: Bears linebacker TJ Edwards reflecting on winning the 2026 Brian Piccolo Award.

statement_made: We’re just excited to get back to football. The building is full of energy, and we’re ready for the 2026 season.
event_description: Commenting on the start of offseason programs at Halas Hall.
